Advocates for data-driven policies against non-communicable diseases, starting with higher tobacco taxes in high-burden countries. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from January 2022, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="concentric-policies-aim">15</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |

| [Concentric Policies: tobacco taxation advocacy (Ambitious Impact, 2022 idea report)](/concentric-policies) | AIM | January 2022 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="concentric-policies-aim">15</span> | 115 |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Concentric Policies existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Concentric Policies runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/zdacfpQdQjfGNoavQ/marginal-funding-for-the-single-best-health-policy-in-the)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
